# CREASE

> CREASE is a free two-player neon air hockey game made for iPhone Duo. One screen, two players, first to 7. Play solo against the CPU (Easy / Normal / Hard) in portrait, or head-to-head in landscape with one player on each side of the glowing center line — the "crease." Dark vaporwave style, created specifically around the iPhone Duo foldable-phone experience. Made by prodbyKCTW (Melvin D. Brown III). No download, no sign-up.

- Genre: Arcade / sports (air hockey)
- Platform: Web browser, mobile-first (iPhone Safari, Android Chrome, desktop); installable as a home-screen app
- Players: 1 (vs CPU) or 2 (same device)
- Price: free
- Developer: prodbyKCTW / RARƎ AGENCY — custom game inquiries via the in-game link
